title: British Columbia / Colombie-Britannique — Health Regions / Régions socio-sanitaires
display_caption: Twenty statistical health regions — published April 2001
reference_year_note: The public map page does not print a boundary date. Its twenty-region framework corresponds to the 2000 statistical geography; the linked original source index is explicitly April 2001. The separately linked 2003 product guide describes the first 2000 digital boundary edition, not a date printed on this map.
scope: Twenty analytical/statistical health regions used around 2000. These are not an assertion of the exact legal boundaries of the 1997–2001 health boards or societies.
notes: Simon Fraser (08) and Burnaby (17) remain separately mapped, as do Vancouver (16) and Richmond (19).
Analytical areas were built from local health areas and generally, rather than perfectly, coincided with board service territories.
This SVG is an unaltered page rendering from the public PDF; it is not a georeferenced GIS boundary dataset.
Source legend contains historical place/region names.
An independently hosted public Statistics Canada map was used. Historical GIS geometry was not acquired.
